evals.prompt: Evaluate a potential breaking change in skills_lint against downstream consumer flutter/flutter. Check if the consumer compiles and passes tests, and verify no downstream changes are committed.
expected_chat_output: The agent checks the downstream consumer against the in-progress commit hash.
The agent highlights that downstream modifications are diagnostic and must never be committed or pushed.
The agent restores or cleans up the downstream workspace after verification.
expected_repo_state: No permanent commits or uncommitted changes remain in the downstream repository.
